summary: Block 6, two parts. (1) Mixture example repaired as instructed: Leb+delta_0 on T^2 under irrational translations was doubly invalid (delta_0 is not translation-invariant; translation does not act on frequency indices). Replaced by mu_lambda = lambda*m_D + (1-lambda)*delta_{1_D} on the actual D with K's automorphism action: both components invariant, a_0 = 1 and a_z = 1-lambda for nonzero z, so pointwise strictness holds, while for z=w!=0 the centered coefficient is lambda(1-lambda) off the single exceptional u=1, giving mean square lambda^2(1-lambda)^2 > 0: M3 fails. It violates ergodicity and wildness (mu_lambda(C) = 1-lambda since 1_D = j(0) is in C), so it is a logical counterexample to strictness alone, not to M3 for the paper's mu. Sign/action convention audited: U_u psi_z = psi_{uz}, index z -> uz. I was also wrong to claim (U) implies M3; withheld. (2) The CENSUS twin pair is settled at source level: the two 153-line proofs differ in exactly 6 lines, and the merge is one general definition plus one theorem plus two wrappers, with no statement change and no new premise. Scaffold uncompiled. Module placement measured: ConditionalLimits already imports ConditionalSpectrum.
verified_results: [proved here] Corrected mixture: m_D invariant (Haar under a continuous automorphism) and delta_{1_D} invariant (u.1_D = 1_D); a_z = 1-lambda for z != 0 since Haar's nontrivial characters integrate to 0 and psi_z(1_D) = 1; mutatis mutandis a_0 = 1. For z = w != 0, a_{uz-w} = 1 exactly at the unique u with uz = w (u = 1 when z = w) and 1-lambda elsewhere, so the centered difference is lambda(1-lambda) off one point and the Folner average tends to lambda^2(1-lambda)^2 > 0: M3 fails while |a_z| < 1 for all nonzero z.

[verified here] The corrected example violates ergodicity (mutually singular invariant m_D and delta_{1_D}, with m_D({1_D}) = 0) and wildness (mu_lambda(C) = 1-lambda, because 1_D = j(0) in C). Hence it separates pointwise strictness from M3 logically, and is NOT a counterexample to M3 for the paper's mu; ergodicity must enter any proof of M3 essentially.

[verified here] Action/sign audit: paper (ad)(z) = d(az) gives (u.d)(z) = d(uz); hence U_u psi_z = psi_{uz}; a_{uz} = a_z under invariance; and a_{-w} = conj(a_w) makes the z = 0 and w = 0 cases of M3 cancel identically.
